a young widow running the place alone and doing it well
twin sisters who finish each other's arguments
a nervous man who owes money to someone in the back room
a retired adventurer with a wall of trophies and tall tales
a halfling matron who knows every guest's name by the second night
a silent giant of a woman who communicates in nods
a former priest who still blesses every barrel
a gossip who trades rumours for tips
a cheerful cook who is plainly running the place instead of the owner
